### Put Your Sword Away
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-april-11-2026.html
Passage: John 18:10-11
Points:
- Peter acted out of passionate devotion, yet his rash violence opposed God's plan.
- Jesus willingly submitted to drinking the Father's cup of suffering for our salvation.
- Human impatience frequently tempts believers to interfere with divine purposes.
- Christians must put away their figurative swords and trust God's timing and direction.

### Wrong Weapon. Wrong Strength. Wrong Attitude.
Author: Love Worth Finding
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-22-2025.html
Passage: Luke 22:49-51
Points:
- Peter struck out with a physical weapon instead of relying on spiritual truth.
- Operating in fleshly zeal after failing to pray led to foolish disaster.
- Human anger damages Christian testimony rather than achieving the righteousness of God.
- Believers must not let emotional hostility replace Spirit-led obedience and good works.

### Jesus Is Arrested
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-april-11-2025.html
Passage: Luke 22:52
Points:
- Despite the chaotic midnight arrest, Jesus remained in complete command of every event.
- Christ stepped forward purposefully to protect His followers and avoid needless conflict.
- The arrival of Judas and the armed mob served to fulfill the Scriptures.
- Believers can trust that God stays in control even when circumstances appear overwhelming.

### Peter’s Misguided Zeal
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/peters-misguided-zeal
Passage: John 18:10-11
Points:
- Peter drew a blade in misguided enthusiasm, attempting to resist an insurmountable force.
- Jesus stopped him because He came purposefully to drink the cup of divine wrath.
- Believers can easily disobey God while mistakenly thinking they are defending Him.
- Christians must seek the Lord's prudence and guidance to keep from stumbling.
